name: smtprelayd Self-Hosted SMTP Relay
free_limit: GPL-3.0-or-later self-hosted SMTP relay software for Windows and Linux with durable queue, SMTP submission, routing, OAuth2/XOAUTH2 Microsoft 365 smarthost integration, JSON API and metrics; no vendor software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Not a free mailbox or hosted email sending service. Requires your own Windows/Linux host, secure SMTP configuration and an existing smarthost (such as Microsoft 365) with separate licensing, sending limits and possible charges. Harden network access to avoid an open relay; upstream reports production use but deployment security remains operator responsibility.
